senses.definition: (skateboarding, surfing, snowboarding) An aerial maneuver in which one catches air by leaping off the ground with the skateboard and into the air.

quotes.text: In short tutorials, the player learns the basics of skating: reverts, manuals and the ollie […]
quotes.reference: 2007, Friedrich von Borries, Steffen P. Walz, Matthias Böttger, Space Time Play: Computer Games, Architecture and Urbanism, page 124:

quotes.text: He used the tilted side as a ramp, grabbed some air, fakied down, and ollied back onto level ground.
